groups.sentence: Instructors plan, before the course, how they will detect and handle suspected violations of the AI policy.
Instructors tell students in advance how they will detect or evaluate AI use, including any detection tools.
Instructors tell students at course start how AI misuse will be handled under the applicable misconduct procedures.
Instructors state the consequences students face for misusing AI.
Instructors act promptly when AI policy violations occur or are suspected.
Instructors may use AI detection tools.
AI detectors are unreliable and do not prove student misconduct.
